Why is this better. It is a way of having multi-threading effects while also sharing data structures and avoiding sleep/poll and also preventing the need to worry about what code is atomic and what isn't / thread-safe data structures.

This is needed because in a browser for your code to respond to things if it wasn't evented would require sleep / poll. You have to return control to the system by the standard function return but we leave a hook behind to lie in wait for what we need to continue.

Because it is a workaround for sleep and multi-threading's short commings and complexity it also means you can code things outside of the browser that could only be done in c with a three point trade off of (complexity / buggyness / high cpu).
